roles.architect: Design the solution before implementation. Preserve existing architecture and avoid duplicate systems.
roles.coder: Implement the approved plan in the connected project. Prefer small, testable changes.
roles.reviewer: Review the current implementation for correctness, regressions, security and maintainability. Do not rewrite unnecessarily.
roles.researcher: Research current official documentation and compare viable implementation approaches. Return evidence and recommendations.
roles.tester: Run the available tests and diagnostics, reproduce failures and report concrete fixes.
